speaker: Doctor

To begin the evaluation, please describe exactly when this swelling started and if it is red or warm to the touch. REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_diff

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the normal CBC results; this suggests the swelling may not be primarily due to a systemic bacterial infection. Is the pain in your right ring finger severe enough to limit your ability to make a fist or move the finger?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That history of the finger being caught and forcefully pulled while playing football is highly suggestive of a tendon injury. Is the pain located specifically at the base of the finger where it meets your palm, or is it along the finger itself? REQUEST IMAGES: X-Ray_Right_Hand

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your description of the finger being stuck in an extended position with an inability to flex the distal joint, combined with the traumatic mechanism you described, this strongly suggests a rupture of the extensor tendon. Can you confirm if there is a visible depression or "step-off" on the dorsal aspect of the finger where the tendon attaches? DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Tendon Avulsion)

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
